newsitem.title: USA: PPG Industries posts Q3 records.
newsitem.headline: PPG Industries posts Q3 records.

text.p: PPG Industries Inc Thursday reported record third-quarter sales, earnings and earnings per share despite European doldrums and some price weakness.
"Early signs that Europe's decline may have bottomed, coupled with PPG's basic strengths and global diversity, augur well for the future," chief executive Jerry Dempsey said.

Record third quarter sales in all three business segments, as well as record operating earnings in coatings and resins and chemicals, were achieved even though European markets remained in the doldrums and pricing was weaker for flat glass and commodity chemicals than in the 1995 period, he said.
Net income for the quarter was $191.1 million, or $1.03 per share, on sales of $1.80 billion, compared with $170.4 million, or $0.85 a share, on sales of $1.72 billion in 1995's third quarter.

"Considering the European economic environment and lower prices for some of our products, it is gratifying to report a 12 percent increase in net income and a 21 percent earnings- per-share increase for the quarter just ended," said Dempsey.
Coatings and resins pefromance benefited from improved pricing, moderating raw material costs, lower overhead and manufacturing efficiencies.

Glass segment sales, a record for a third quarter, grew on overall volume improvements and stronger fiber glass prices. Although flat glass prices were lower, operating earnings held steady with those of a year ago, due in part to ongoing manufacturing efficiencies and lower overhead.

Record chemicals sales and operating earnings were achieved despite weaker commodity chemical prices and increased energy costs. This performance was attributed in part to higher volumes in all major product lines, led by specialty chemicals, as well as ongoing manufacturing efficiencies. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
